# Gammaterial

**Gammaterial** is a solid (drilled tile by tile) ore. Each extraction yields **150** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. Extracting this ore requires the matching enabler effect to be active on the robot. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/formats/ore-fields/).

## Extraction

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Amount / extraction | 150 |
| Extraction type | solid (drilled tile by tile) |
| Enabler effect | required |
